latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of PPT Maker — Convert Slides into Shareable Videos.

- Instantly convert PowerPoint slides into 1080p videos by uploading your presentation and describing your needs.
- Automatic backend connection setup, including anonymous authentication when needed.
- Cloud GPU processing delivers video exports (MP4, up to 1080p) in about 1–2 minutes.
- Supports direct file uploads (PPT, PPTX, PDF, images, audio, and more) with a 200MB size limit.
- Simple text prompts route to actions like export, check credits, view status, or upload.
- User-friendly error handling and streamlined workflows: quick edits, batch processing, and iterative updates.
